stem: During DNA replication, what role does each parental chain play?

options.label: A
options.text: It templates a new complementary chain
options.misconception: None; each parental chain templates a complement.
options.explanation: OpenStax: each strand serves as a template for a new complementary strand.

options.label: B
options.text: It binds oxygen as the terminal acceptor
options.misconception: ETC confusion — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: C
options.text: It is discarded and replaced by RNA only

options.label: D
options.text: It is converted into glycogen stores
options.misconception: Category error — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: E
options.explanation: Wrong process; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: parental DNA strands are templates.
imageCaption: DNA double helix; strands template replication; codon triplets; central dogma DNA to protein.
